note: North Macedonia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days in any 180 (Georgia 90). Everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen visas, or of Canadian, UK or US multiple-entry visas in 2026, may enter for 15 days; Belarusians with a tourist voucher: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.
